description: Angular component for a dialog to add entities to an edge, supporting multiple entity types and handling form submission and assignment logic.

classes.name: AddEntitiesToEdgeDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular dialog component for assigning various entity types to an edge, with form validation and assignment logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and sets titles based on entity type.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without making changes.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Handles the assignment of selected entities to the edge.

methods.name: getAssignToEdgeTask
methods.description: Returns the observable for assigning a specific entity to an edge based on entity type.
